@syntax Handle(object)
@syntax Handle:Int32(object)
Converts an object of a custom type to an integer that stands for it, which can be stored in a Bank, a file or passed to code that only knows numbers. [Object](Object) converts it back. Every object has the same handle for as long as it exists.

```blitzbasic
;run
Type Thing
	Field n
End Type

t.Thing = New Thing
t\n = 7
h = Handle(t)
u.Thing = Object.Thing(h)
Print u\n
Print Handle(t) = h
```

```text
7
1
```
